title: Formal-methods coursework with attributed AskGPT use
summary: Students complete Forge and Python assignments, projects, and labs in an upper-level formal-methods course. They may use the course-provided AskGPT extension without limits and may submit its generated work if they attribute the use; other LLM tools remain prohibited.

sources.title: Generating Programs Trivially: Student Use of Large Language Models
sources.evidence_quote: There are 8 assignments in total (5 Forge, 3 Python), 4 major projects (all Forge), and 9 labs (6 Forge, 3 Python).

course.name: Logic for Systems
course.institution: a highly selective private university in the United States

context.learner_level: primarily third- and fourth-year undergraduate students
prerequisites: Experience comparable to CS1 and CS2

assessment.summary: Write formal specifications, programs, tests, and models in Forge and Python across the course workload.
student_actions: Write Forge specifications, Python programs, tests, and project solutions.
Attribute any AskGPT-generated content submitted for credit.

student_role.description: Students could use AskGPT for any coursework purpose and could submit generated solutions with attribution.

prohibited_actions: Use LLM tools other than AskGPT
